title: Pi Agent Policy

description.en: User-level Pi tool policies and bounded recovery
description.zh: 用户级 Pi 工具策略与有界恢复

subject: Compact graphite push-to-reset instrument with an ivory face, terracotta button and brass contacts

subject.en: Graphite reset instrument with terracotta enamel control
subject.zh: 带陶土色珐琅按键的石墨复位器

description.en: A compact instrument floats in a measured three-quarter view. The housing, button and two contacts remain complete, uniformly inset from the rounded outline.
description.zh: 紧凑仪器从斜侧方悬浮呈现，外壳、按钮和两个触点完整保留，整体等比内收，为圆角边界留足空间。

description.en: Graphite, ivory, terracotta enamel, steel and brass give policy and bounded recovery a physical metaphor. Original material colors and opaque highlights survive transparent extraction; this is not a sandbox claim.
description.zh: 石墨、象牙白、陶土色珐琅、钢和黄铜，把策略与有界恢复转译为实体工具。透明提取保留原始材质颜色和不透明高光；这个隐喻不代表系统沙箱。

title.en: Interrupted contacts and a single return

description.en: Paired contact stops and one returning trace, pressed into warm mineral paper. The open circuit and short reset path echo bounded recovery; their geometry belongs to this instrument, without copying another project's circuit grid.
description.zh: 暖矿物纸底上压印成对的触点断口和一条返回轨迹，呼应有限的恢复机会。纹理、细颗粒和柔和投影独立于透明标志。

sizeNote.zh: 24/16px 下以石墨轮廓和红色按键保持识别，细密滚花与金属反光会柔化。小尺寸使用透明前景，不加底板、遮罩或额外红点。本扩展没有独立网页界面。

source.description: User-level Pi tool policies and bounded recovery

goal.en: Install once in the Pi user directory to apply declarative tool policies across projects. Policy repairs and eligible terminal recovery share one allowance per original user input; the extension returns real native-tool alternatives and waits for agent_settled before recovery. The repository is currently private, and there is no independent website.
goal.zh: 在 Pi 用户目录安装一次，即可跨项目应用声明式工具策略。策略修复与符合条件的终止恢复共用每次原始输入的一次额度；工具受限时返回真实原生替代工具，恢复等待 agent_settled。仓库目前为私有，没有独立站点。

role.en: Public extension events, native tool schemas and user-directory installation
role.zh: 公开扩展事件、原生工具 schema 与用户级安装

role.en: Declarative rules, shared repair budget and versioned installer
role.zh: 声明式规则、共享修复额度与版本化安装器

role.en: Pinned shell parser; unknown syntax defaults to known commands only
role.zh: 固定版本 shell 解析器；未知语法默认仅检查已知命令

description.en: An instrument service mat: a fine locating grid, an open contact and one marked return. The grid echoes declared rules, the break an intercepted tool call, and the terracotta trace the single shared repair allowance.
description.zh: 借用精密仪器检修垫的语言：细密定位栅格、断开的触点、一条标记清楚的返回线。栅格对应声明式规则，断口对应被拦截的工具调用，陶土色回路对应共用的一次修复机会。

alt.en: Graphite reset instrument with terracotta enamel control on a Hexly campaign canvas
alt.zh: 带陶土色珐琅按键的石墨复位器，置于 Hexly 宣发画布

description.en: A graphite reset instrument for user-level Pi tool policies and bounded recovery.
description.zh: 石墨复位器，呈现用户级 Pi 工具策略与有界恢复。

description.en: Preserve the exact project identity and the separately recorded Hexly artwork. Hexly paper, ink and terracotta belong to archive and campaign surfaces only; independent product palettes and themes stay their own.
description.zh: 项目原标与单独记录的 Hexly 主视觉均保持形状和原色。Hexly 纸色、墨色和陶土色只用于档案及宣发画布，各产品色板与主题独立保留。

description.en: Preserve the complete subject and its original square margins. Resize uniformly; never trim the canvas to force detail. Keep external clear space of at least 1/8 of the mark canvas height around standalone marks and lockups. Wide and mobile Heroes are separate compositions of existing artwork, with no image-model call.
description.zh: 保留完整主体与原有方形留白，只做等比缩放，不裁图强凑细节。独立标志及字标组合四周，至少留出标志画布高度 1/8 的外部净空。宽幅与手机 Hero 分别排版，没有新图像模型调用。

description.en: Navigation 24px preferred, 16px minimum. Wordmark ≥143px wide; lockup ≥164px. Use transparent PNG/ICO at small sizes without a tile, extra red dot, shadow or rounded mask. Fine material detail softens at 16px.
description.zh: 导航推荐 24px，最小 16px。字标宽度至少 143px，组合至少 164px。小尺寸使用透明 PNG/ICO，不加底板、红点、阴影或圆角遮罩；16px 时细小材质细节会柔化。
